https://github.com/intgrah/metalean

I am proud to announce Metalean, a verified typechecker for an idealised version of Lean's type theory without nested inductives.

The checker is positively sound (acceptance implies derivability), but not negatively sound (rejection implies underivability), and is partial (it may not terminate on some inputs).

Furthermore, it is proven that the type theory is consistent with ZFC Set theory + inaccessibles.

There is a (completely verified) "logical" checker, which, while effectively executable, is not usable for various reasons, and there is (verified up to unsafe code/prelude assumptions) "fast" checker, which is usable, and supports Nat/String literals and accelerated operations, under the assumption that the prelude is not tampered with. The fast checker attempts to be faithful to the official Lean kernel. It uses unsafe/implemented_by for performance reasons, which is of course unverifiable currently.

After filtering out nested inductives and their dependents (90% of code is retained) from mathlib, the "fast" checker is able to typecheck it in about 5 hours (but this is to be improved)
